verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows account-based entry points ('Connexion à l'espace professionnel', 'Connexion à mon espace Finances publiques') and bare link titles such as 'Payer en ligne', 'Vérifier un avis d'impôt' and 'Simuler une taxe'. None of these items document that the core online flow can be started without an account, or via a keyless or file-number entry path. Link titles alone do not establish account-free access, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
